summary: Bedford County, PA lookout on Martin Hill: tree tower 1912, steel tower 1921, removed 2001 or 2002 (sources differ); the summit now holds communication towers.

facts.design: steel tower built in fall 1921 (township: steel aeromotor tower, 68 ft); earlier tree observation post 25 ft up from 1912
facts.status_note: Steel tower removed in 2002 per FFLOS, but March 17, 2001 per the Southampton Township history, which also says the summit now holds communication towers

staffing.status: watch person manned the tower each fall in high fire season; Towerman Irvin Ruby reported two fires in 1927

visit.trail_note: Township says state forest trails are open to licensed ATVs for part of the year; no source says whether the summit is open to visitors

events.note: First tree tower: a tree observation post 25 feet above the ground
Steel tower replaced the tree tower; township dates the build to fall 1921 at a cost of $610.03
Towerman Irvin Ruby reported two fires in 1927 and nineteen in 1928
Careless fire destroyed 1,150 acres on May 4 and 5 (950 timber, 200 brush), per township
Stolen car and four acres of underbrush burned around the tower in November 1975
Township: removed March 17, 2001, after DER quietly sold it for $300 (the register gives 2002)
Steel tower removed, per FFLOS (township gives March 2001)
Registered September 16, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register gives 2,720 ft (829 m) for the site and the township gives 2,700 ft for the tower site; a 1921 Bedford newspaper gives 3,096 ft for the top of the hill. The story reports the figures without choosing one.

The register says the steel tower replaced the tree tower in 1921; the township says it was built in fall 1921; an August 1921 item said Martin Hill would be among the first towers put up that summer.
The register says the steel tower was removed in 2002; the township says it was removed March 17, 2001, when DER quietly sold it for $300. The story gives both dates and attributes each.

notes_for_editor: Brief had no height; 68 ft (20.7 m) comes only from the township page. Removal date conflicts: 2002 per FFLOS, March 17, 2001 per the township; the story gives both, attributed. Summit access is not established. Brief elevation 829.1 m matches FFLOS. Brief agency kept as given; Forest Lookouts and the township both place the tower in Buchanan State Forest.
